text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, Corvale East holds 121 vials of fosphenytoin sodium 50 mg/mL 10 mL with 7 used per day, providing 17.2 days on hand. Corvale General holds 140 vials with 8.1 used per day, providing 17.3 days on hand. Corvale Lakeside holds 54 vials with 2.2 used per day, providing 24 days on hand.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include fosphenytoin sodium as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory across all three sites provides approximately 17 to 24 days of supply. No manufacturer is listed on FDA's shortage list today. Multiple purchasing options are available from suppliers not on the shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer to place orders with Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC as the top-ranked option; requires buyer approval.
2. Buyer to qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as a secondary source; requires buyer approval.
3. Buyer to qualify GLENMARK PHARMACEUTICALS INC., USA as a tertiary source; requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer to monitor daily usage and inventory levels at all three sites; requires buyer approval.
5. Buyer to report any supply disruption to the P&T committee within 24 hours; requires buyer approval.

Not recommended: No allocation restrictions or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
